const t1 = (_v: undefined, _c: ClassFieldDecoratorContext) => (v: number) => { console.log('t1'); return v + 1; };
const t2 = (_v: undefined, _c: ClassFieldDecoratorContext) => (v: number) => { console.log('t2'); return v * 10; };
const a1 = (_v: unknown, _c: ClassAccessorDecoratorContext) => ({ init: (v: number) => v + 1 });
const a2 = (_v: unknown, _c: ClassAccessorDecoratorContext) => ({ init: (v: number) => v * 10 });
class A {
  @t1 @t2 x = 1;
  @a1 @a2 accessor y = 1;
  @t1 @t2 static s = 1;
}
const a = new A();
console.log(a.x, a.y, A.s);
